sections.title: Day 52 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
- 掌握招募、面試、錄取談判與新人入職相關字彙
- 熟練名詞子句 what / that / whether 與關係詞 whose、whoever、介系詞 + which 混合判斷
- 辨認 Part 2 反問與間接回應：用問題回答問題、用事實暗示答案
- 解讀 Part 7 文字訊息串意圖題，並整合職缺公告、訊息串與錄取信計算總額
- 強化 Part 6 入職通知信的非限定關係子句與篇章收尾

建議訓練時間：**115 分鐘**。

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜名詞子句 what / that / whether 與關係詞 whose、whoever、介系詞 + which 混合
sections.markdown:
主題：**名詞子句 what / that / whether 與關係詞 whose、whoever、介系詞 + which 混合**

### 規則 1｜what 與 that 引導名詞子句

what = the thing(s) that，子句內本身缺主詞或受詞；that 後接完整子句，本身不當成分。

> What the hiring manager values most is reliability.

### 規則 2｜whether 與 if 的差別

兩者都表「是否」，但放句首當主詞、接在介系詞後、或直接接 or not 時，只能用 whether。

> Whether the candidate accepts depends on the signing bonus.

### 規則 3｜whoever / whomever / whichever

複合關係詞的格由「子句內」角色決定，不看前面的介系詞或動詞。

> The bonus will go to whoever refers the successful applicant.

### 規則 4｜所有格關係代名詞 whose

whose + 名詞，先行詞可以是人或物；most of whose、all of whose 等數量詞用法常見於 Part 5。

> The panel, most of whose members are directors, approved the offer.

### 規則 5｜介系詞 + which / whom；逗號後不用 that

介系詞後只能接 which / whom；非限定子句（逗號後）不可用 that。

> The orientation, during which badges are issued, starts at nine.

sections.title: 03 Listening｜Scheduling Candidate Interviews
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Man: Alana, have you finished screening the applicants for the logistics analyst position? Woman: Didn't you see the shortlist I sent last night? Man: Oh, I haven't checked my e-mail since this morning's meeting. How many made it? Woman: Five. But one of them, Mr. Osei, wants to know whether we can hold the panel interview remotely. Man: Isn't he relocating from Halifax? Woman: Yes, which is why he'd prefer not to fly in twice. Man: Then a video interview for the first round should be fine. Should we invite the other four in person? Woman: Wouldn't it be fairer to interview everyone the same way? Man: Good point. Let's do all five by video and bring the finalists in afterward.

sections.title: 04 Listening｜Negotiating a Job Offer
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Woman: Daniel, Ms. Okafor responded to our offer letter. She's excited about the role, but she asked whether we could raise the starting salary from sixty-eight thousand to seventy-four thousand dollars. Man: Seventy-four is above the approved range for that position. The ceiling is seventy-one. Woman: I know. I was going to tell her we couldn't move at all, but she mentioned she has a competing offer. Man: In that case, let's not lose her over a few thousand dollars. Offer seventy-one, plus a one-time signing bonus of three thousand. The bonus comes out of a separate recruiting budget. Woman: That would bring her first-year total to seventy-four thousand, which is exactly what she asked for. Man: Right. And remind her that the relocation allowance is paid separately. Woman: I'll call her this afternoon, and if she agrees, I'll send a revised offer letter by tomorrow.

sections.title: 05 Listening｜New-Hire Orientation Briefing
sections.markdown:
先閱讀題目，再聆聽內容並完成作答。

聽力稿：

> Welcome to Brightwater Analytics, and thank you for joining us for new-hire orientation. Before we begin, there's one change to today's schedule. The building tour, originally set for eleven o'clock, will now take place right after lunch, because the security office needs the morning to print your ID badges. So this morning, you'll complete your payroll paperwork and enroll in the company health plan. Please note that the enrollment deadline is thirty days from your start date. If you miss it, you'll have to wait until the next open enrollment period in November. Each of you has also been assigned a mentor from your department, who will meet you here at three o'clock. During your ninety-day probationary period, you and your mentor will meet every two weeks. Finally, if you have questions about benefits, please e-mail the HR help desk rather than your manager.

sections.title: ⑥ Reading｜Hiring Process: Job Posting, Text Messages, and Offer E-mail
sections.markdown:
限時：**10 分 0 秒**。

### Job Posting

> Kestrel Biomedical is seeking a Clinical Data Coordinator for its Boston office. Requirements: a bachelor's degree in a related field, at least three years of experience managing clinical trial data, and proficiency in statistical software. Certification as a Clinical Data Manager is preferred but not required. Salary range: $62,000–$70,000. Candidates who accept an offer within seven days of receiving it will receive a $2,500 signing bonus. A relocation allowance of up to $4,000 is available to candidates moving more than 50 miles. Applications close March 14. All offers are conditional upon a satisfactory background check.

用途：參考文件

### Text Message Chain

> Rita Gomez [10:31 A.M.]: Just got off the phone with Lena Park. She loved the panel interview and will accept if we can offer $68,000.
> Tom Haley [10:33 A.M.]: That's within range. Did she say when she could start?
> Rita Gomez [10:34 A.M.]: April 7. She needs to give notice at her current job first.
> Tom Haley [10:36 A.M.]: Her references came back strong. Has the background check cleared?
> Rita Gomez [10:37 A.M.]: Not yet. The agency expects to finish this week.
> Mei Chen [10:39 A.M.]: Quick question. Is she moving from Hartford? That's about 115 miles.
> Rita Gomez [10:40 A.M.]: She is.
> Mei Chen [10:41 A.M.]: Then she qualifies for the relocation allowance. I'll add it to the offer letter and send it out this afternoon.
> Tom Haley [10:42 A.M.]: Let's not get ahead of ourselves.
> Tom Haley [10:43 A.M.]: Nothing goes out until the background check clears. And since you'll be her mentor, Mei, please block out time on April 7.

用途：參考文件

### Offer E-mail

> From: Rita Gomez, Human Resources
> To: Lena Park
> Date: March 24
>
> Dear Ms. Park, I am pleased to confirm that your background check was completed on March 23. Kestrel Biomedical is offering you the position of Clinical Data Coordinator at an annual salary of $68,000, beginning April 7. Because you are relocating from more than 50 miles away, you will receive a relocation allowance of $3,500, based on the moving estimate you submitted. In addition, if you sign and return the attached offer letter by March 31, you will receive the signing bonus described in our job posting. Your first three months will be a probationary period, during which you will meet regularly with your mentor.

用途：參考文件

sections.title: ⑨ Day 52 小考
sections.markdown: 正式限時：**6 分 0 秒**。

sections.title: ⑩ 複習與錯題分類
sections.markdown:
回顧 **Day 49、Day 50、Day 51**。

### 複習重點
- 訊息串意圖題：引號句要看「前一則在說什麼」與「下一則補充什麼」
- Part 2 反問（Didn't you...? / Isn't it...?）常是正確答案，字音重複的選項多為陷阱
- what 子句缺成分、that 子句完整；句首或介系詞後用 whether 不用 if
- whoever / whomever 看子句內角色
- Preferred ≠ Required；up to $4,000 ≠ 一定拿到 $4,000
- 複習 Day 51：Should 倒裝條件、I was going to... but... 立場改變

### 錯題標籤
- `G`：Grammar
- `NC`：Noun Clause
- `REL`：Relative Pronoun
- `L`：Listening
- `IND`：Indirect Response
- `SHIFT`：Speaker Position Shift
- `INT`：Intent（引號句意圖）
- `DETAIL`：Key Detail
- `I`：Information Integration
- `CALC`：Calculation
- `E`：Exception / Requirement vs Preference
- `V`：Vocabulary

sections.title: ⑪ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
- 複習今日 30 個單字，選 8 個各造一個招募或入職情境的句子。
- Part 5 15 題首次限時 4 分鐘，第二輪 3 分 30 秒。
- Part 6 4 題重做，說明 [2]、[3] 為何選 which / who。
- Listening 三組各練兩次，第二輪使用 TTS 1.1x 且不看逐字稿，寫下第一組每個反問句真正要表達的意思。
- 重新整理 Kestrel 錄取流程：職缺條件 → 訊息串決定 → 錄取信金額與期限，並驗算 $74,000。
- Day 52 Quiz 第二輪限時 5 分 30 秒，記錄首次答案、耗時與 errorTags。

questions.prompt: _____ impressed the panel most was the candidate's experience with payroll systems.
questions.explanation: What 引導名詞子句當主詞，子句內缺主詞（= The thing that impressed...）。

questions.prompt: The recruiter asked _____ the applicant would be willing to relocate.
questions.explanation: ask whether + 完整子句，表「是否」。

questions.prompt: The award will go to _____ refers the most qualified candidates this quarter.
questions.explanation: 複合關係代名詞在子句中作 refers 的主詞，用主格 whoever；格由子句內角色決定，不受介系詞 to 影響。

questions.prompt: Ms. Liu, _____ résumé was forwarded by a former colleague, has been shortlisted.
questions.explanation: 所有格關係代名詞 whose + 名詞（résumé）。

questions.prompt: The orientation session, during _____ new hires receive their ID badges, lasts two hours.
questions.explanation: 介系詞 + which；介系詞後不能接 that。

questions.prompt: _____ the candidate accepts the counteroffer will depend on the size of the signing bonus.
questions.explanation: 名詞子句放句首當主詞只能用 whether，不能用 if。

questions.prompt: The fact _____ staff turnover fell by 12 percent suggests the mentoring program is working.
questions.explanation: 同位語子句 the fact that + 完整子句。

questions.prompt: All new employees must complete their payroll paperwork _____ their first week of employment.
questions.explanation: within + 期間：在…之內。

questions.prompt: The job offer is _____ upon the successful completion of a background check.
questions.explanation: be conditional upon：以…為條件。

questions.prompt: The hiring committee has not yet decided _____ of the two finalists will receive the offer.
questions.explanation: 限定在兩位之中選一，用 which of...

questions.prompt: The company offers a generous relocation _____ to employees who move more than 50 miles.
questions.explanation: relocation allowance 搬遷津貼。

questions.prompt: When asked whether she would accept, Ms. Romero gave a _____ answer, saying only that she needed more time.
questions.explanation: noncommittal 不表態的，與 needed more time 呼應。

questions.prompt: To reduce staff _____, the firm introduced quarterly retention bonuses.
questions.explanation: staff turnover 人員流動率。

questions.prompt: HR will contact the two candidates _____ the hiring manager selected for a second interview.
questions.explanation: 關係代名詞作 selected 的受詞，用 whom。

questions.prompt: _____ you need help enrolling in the health plan, please contact the HR help desk.
questions.explanation: 複習 Day 51：Should 倒裝條件 = If you should need...

questions.prompt: Which option best completes blank [3]?

options.B: She will arrive at the interview early.
options.C: She wants to reschedule her flight.

keyTakeaway: 掌握招募、錄取談判與入職流程字彙；分辨 what / that / whether 名詞子句與 whose、whoever、介系詞 + which；聽懂 Part 2 反問與間接回應，並判讀訊息串引號句的真正意圖。
